DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Hello. What can I do for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この手紙を送りたいのですが、封筒の外には何も書いていません。中の紙には宛名があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 本文にだけ宛名があり外面未記入の手紙を送る相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I'd like to send this letter, but I haven't written anything on the envelope. The recipient's name is on the paper inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask about mailing a letter with the recipient only inside and the envelope blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 配達用の宛先は、封筒の外側に必要です。宛先がわかる控えをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: The delivery address needs to be outside the envelope. Do you have a copy of the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: スマートフォンに住所があります。封を開けずに、外へ書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: スマートフォンの住所控えを見て封を開けず外へ書くか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I have the address on my smartphone. Should I write it on the outside without opening the envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm whether to copy the smartphone address onto the outside without opening the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。控えを見ながら、宛先を外側へ書きましょう。ご自身の住所とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. Use your copy to write the destination outside. Keep it separate from your own address.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 差出人の住所を先に大きく書きそうになりました。書く位置を示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 差出人住所を大きく書きそうになったと説明し記入位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I nearly wrote the sender's address large first. Could you show me where to write each one?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that you almost wrote the sender's address large and ask where to write it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この見本では、表に宛先、裏に差出人を示しています。実際の封筒に合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: This example shows the recipient on the front and sender on the back. We'll check according to your actual envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 郵便番号も、相手のものと私のものをそれぞれの面に書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 相手と本人の郵便番号を各面に書く理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll also put their postal code and mine on the respective sides, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm that the recipient's and your own postal codes belong on their respective sides. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その理解で合っています。書き終えたら、宛先側をもう一度見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: That's correct. Once you're finished, show me the recipient's side again.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 封を開けずに宛先と差出人を書き分け、控えと照合してから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 宛先と差出人を分けて控えと照合して差し出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Without opening the envelope, I'll write the recipient and sender separately, check them against my copy, and then hand it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you'll distinguish recipient and sender, compare with your copy, and hand over the letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お待ちしています。書き終わりましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-ISHINOMAKI-08-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll be here. Please let us know when you've finished writing.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 原料箱の日付を製品ラベルに写そうとしました。これが製造日でしょうか。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原料箱の日付を製品ラベルへ写す前に製造日か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to copy the date on the raw-material box onto the product label. Is this the manufacturing date?
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the raw-material box's date is the manufacturing date before copying it onto a product label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その箱の表示は原料の受入日です。製品の製造日とは区別します。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: The date on that box is when the raw material was received. It's different from the product's manufacturing date.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受入日でしたか。まだラベルは印刷していません。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受入日だったと理解しラベル未印刷だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was the receipt date. I haven't printed any labels yet.
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it's the receipt date and say the labels aren't printed yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 印刷前でよかったです。製造日は担当の作業記録で確認してください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's good you checked before printing. Confirm the manufacturing date in the responsible person's work record.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この記録のどの欄を見るか、指導担当に教えてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業記録の該当欄を指導担当に教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like the trainer to show me which field in this record to look at.
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the trainer to show you the relevant work-record field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。日付だけでなく、対象の製品名と作業番号も照合します。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll call them. We'll compare not just the date, but also the product name and work number.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 似た製品の記録が隣にあるので、名前と番号を先に確認します。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た製品の記録と混ぜず名称と作業番号を先に照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a similar product's record beside it, so I'll check the name and number first.
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll first match the name and work number without confusing it with a similar product's record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確認が済むまでは数字を推測して入力しないでください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Don't guess and enter any numbers before the check is finished.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入力を止め、原料の受入日を写しかけたことを担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入力を止め受入日を写しかけた経緯を報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stop entering data and tell the person in charge that I nearly copied the raw-material receipt date.
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll stop entering data and report that you nearly copied the receipt date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。担当と確認してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-KESENNUMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Proceed only after checking with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Welcome. Are you looking for something?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 冷凍の品を買いたいです。保冷箱に入れれば、車の中に夕方まで置けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 冷凍商品を保冷箱に入れ車内へ夕方まで置けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to buy a frozen product. If I put it in an insulated box, can I leave it in the car until evening?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether frozen goods in an insulated box can stay in the car until evening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 保冷箱だけで冷凍状態が続くとは限りません。何時ごろ帰宅されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: An insulated box alone won't necessarily keep it frozen. What time will you get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 夜になります。途中で冷凍庫に入れる予定もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 帰宅は夜で途中に冷凍庫がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: At night. I don't have any plans to put it in a freezer along the way either.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain you'll return at night and have no freezer available on the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: でしたら、その予定で冷凍品を選ぶのは難しいです。保存表示に合う持ち帰り方を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then choosing frozen goods for that itinerary is difficult. Let's think of a way home that meets the storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 保冷箱が冷凍庫の代わりだと思っていました。常温で持ち帰る品を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 保冷箱を冷凍庫代わりと思っていたと訂正し常温品を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought an insulated box could replace a freezer. I'd like to look at products I can take home at room temperature.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Correct your assumption that an insulated box replaces a freezer and ask to see room-temperature products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらに常温保存の表示がある商品があります。直射日光などの注意も読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: These products are labeled for room-temperature storage. Read the precautions about direct sunlight too.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 車内の暑さにも注意が必要ですね。かばんに入れて自分で持ち歩ける小さい物を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 車内の暑さも考え自分で携帯できる小さい品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I need to consider the heat inside the car as well. I'll choose something small enough to carry around in my bag myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Consider car heat and say you'll choose a small item you can carry with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この小箱なら持ち運びやすいですね。帰宅後の保存表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This small box would be easy to carry. Check its storage instructions for after you get home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 冷凍品は今日は買わず、この常温の小箱だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 冷凍品を買わず常温小箱だけ購入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I won't buy frozen goods today; I'll just take this small room-temperature box.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide not to buy frozen goods and purchase only the small room-temperature box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。お会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please come to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この払込票で支払いたいです。端の紙を先に切り離してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 払込票で支払う前に端を切り離してよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to pay with this payment slip. May I tear off the strip at the edge first?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can detach the edge before paying with the payment slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず用紙全体を見せてください。収納に使う部分まで切らないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please show me the whole form first. Let's avoid tearing off a section needed for processing the payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 裏の説明を読まずに、この線から切ろうとしていました。まだ切っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 説明未読で線から切ろうとしたがまだ切っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was about to tear along this line without reading the instructions on the back. I haven't torn it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you nearly tore along the line without reading the instructions but haven't done so yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: バーコードを含む状態で確認します。期限と、当店で扱える票かも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll check it with the barcode intact, including the deadline and whether our store can handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。手元にはこの一枚だけなので、必要な部分をなくしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一枚しかないため必要部分を失わず確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. This is the only copy I have, so I don't want to lose a necessary part.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for checking without losing necessary parts because you have only one copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この学習用の票は扱えます。切り離さずレジへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can accept this practice payment slip. Please hand it to the cashier without detaching anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 支払った後に戻る控えは、用紙のどの部分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 支払後に返される控えの部分を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Which part of the form will I get back as my receipt after paying?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask which portion will be returned after payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受領印を付けたお客様用の控えをお返しします。戻る物を受け取ってからご確認ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらのレジでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. We'll take it at this register.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 汗をふくシートを探しています。この濡れたシートも顔に使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 汗拭き用途で濡れたシートを顔に使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm looking for wipes to wipe off sweat. Can I use these wet wipes on my face too?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the wet wipes can be used on your face for wiping sweat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは住居の掃除用です。顔や体に使う商品とは用途が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: These are for household cleaning. They're for a different use from products for the face and body.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表の絵だけ見ていました。裏には床や家具用とありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 掃除用の裏面表示に気づき表の絵だけ見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I only looked at the picture on the front. The back says for floors and furniture.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Notice the cleaning-purpose label on the back and explain you only looked at the front picture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。肌に使う物はこちらの売場です。顔にも使いたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Products for skin are in this section. Do you want to use them on your face too?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 顔と首に使いたいです。香りの強くない物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 顔と首用で香りの強くない商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like them for my face and neck, and I'd prefer something without a strong fragrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request a product for face and neck without a strong scent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 使用できる部位と香りの表示を見比べましょう。この二つは用途が異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's compare the labels for allowed body areas and fragrance. These two have different uses.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは体用だけですね。顔にも使える表示のあるほうを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 体用だけの商品を除き顔用表示のある物を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: This one is for the body only, then. I'll choose the one labeled suitable for the face too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Exclude the body-only product and choose one labeled for facial use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表示の注意も読んでからご使用ください。掃除用は元の棚へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Read the label precautions before using it too. I'll put the cleaning wipes back on their shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 顔に使える用途を確認できました。この商品を一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 顔への使用対象を確認し商品一つを購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've confirmed it's suitable for my face. I'll buy one of these.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm facial use is covered and say you'll buy one product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. Please bring it to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どんなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Welcome. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入れ物の幅を測りたいです。この定規は端から測ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 収納用品の測定で定規の端を始点にすればよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to measure a container's width. Should I start measuring from the edge of this ruler?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ruler's edge is the starting point when measuring a storage item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この学習用定規では、ゼロの線が端より少し内側にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: On this practice ruler, the zero line is a little in from the edge.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 端を当てていたので、前に測った幅もずれているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 端で測った既存寸法がずれている可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was aligning it with the edge, so the width I measured earlier may be off too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that your earlier dimensions may be inaccurate because you measured from the edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 測る物の端をゼロ線に合わせてください。どの部分へ入れる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Align the edge of the item with the zero line. Where are you planning to put it?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 机の引き出しです。外側の幅だけでなく、口の内側を測る必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 引き出し用なので口の内側の寸法も必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: In a desk drawer. So I need to measure the inside opening as well, rather than just the outside width.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that a drawer requires the inside opening's dimensions too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。引き出しの内寸の控えと、商品の外寸を比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Let's compare your recorded inside dimensions with the product's outside dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 内寸は端から測った数字しかないので、今日は買わずに測り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 正しい内寸がないため今日は購入せず再計測すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The only inside measurements I have were taken from the ruler's edge, so I won't buy it today; I'll measure again.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Decide not to buy today and to remeasure because you lack correct internal dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それでしたら、必要な測り方を見本で確かめておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then let's check the necessary measuring method using the sample first.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ゼロ線を合わせて引き出しの口と奥を測り、数字を控えてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: ゼロ線で口と奥の寸法を測り控えてから選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll align the zero line, measure both the drawer opening and the back, and write down the numbers before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll measure the opening and back from the zero line and record them before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。測り直してからまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please come back to ask after you've measured again.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Welcome. Are you looking for something?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この問題集には答えが見当たりません。解答は別に買うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 問題集に答えが見当たらず解答が別売か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can't find the answers in this workbook. Do I buy them separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether answers are sold separately because you can't find them in the workbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この学習用商品は別冊解答が付属します。見本では後ろの袋に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: This learning product includes a separate answer booklet. In the sample, it's in the pocket at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 本体の最後のページだけ探していました。袋の中にあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本体末尾だけ探し袋内の別冊を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was only searching the last pages of the main book. So it's in the pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you looked only at the main book's end and missed the separate booklet in the pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。販売用は本体と解答を一組にして包んであります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Sale copies are wrapped as a set of the main book and answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 買う前に別冊が入っていることを、外から確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 購入前に付属別冊が入ることを外から確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Before buying, can I confirm from outside that the separate booklet is included?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can confirm the included booklet from outside before purchasing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この付属品表示をご覧ください。中身の見本はこちらの開封済みセットで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Look at this list of included items. You can check the contents in this opened sample set.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 見本で説明の量を読みたいです。販売用の包みは開けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 販売用を開けず見本の解説量を読みたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to read the sample to see how much explanation there is. I won't open the sale package.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to read the amount of explanation in the sample without opening a sale copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どうぞ。解答だけでなく簡単な解説も載せた見本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. The sample includes brief explanations as well as answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: この内容なら自分で復習できます。本体と別冊の一組を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 復習に合う内容と判断し本体と別冊の一組を購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: With this content, I can review by myself. I'll buy one set of the main book and separate booklet.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide the content suits self-review and buy one set of the main book and booklet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらの未開封セットをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. Please take this unopened set.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 問診票に前と同じ歯が痛いと書きましたが、今回は反対側でした。直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 歯科問診で前回と同じ歯と書いたが反対側なので訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I wrote on the dental questionnaire that the same tooth as before hurts, but this time it's the opposite side. I'd like to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you wrote the same tooth as before on the dental form, but it's the opposite side and you want to correct it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どちら側を今回痛むと感じていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Which side do you feel pain on this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今回は右です。前は左だったので、同じ欄に左と書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 今回は右で前回左の記憶から左と誤記したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The right this time. It was the left before, so I wrote left in the same field by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain it's the right this time and you mistakenly wrote left from remembering last time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: わかりました。今感じていることを、前回の経過と分けて記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Let's write your current symptoms separately from the previous episode.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いつ痛むかも書きたいです。噛んだときに気になりますが、原因はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 噛む時に痛む症状を加え原因は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to write when it hurts too. I notice it when biting, but I don't know the cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Add the symptom of pain when biting and say the cause is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 症状と気づいた場面をそのまま書いてください。原因の判断は診療担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Write the symptoms and when you noticed them as they are. The clinician will determine the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受付で歯を決めつけず、診察のときに右側を指して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 歯を自己判断で決めず診察で右側を指して説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't decide which tooth it is at reception; I'll point to the right side and explain during the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you won't determine the tooth yourself and will point to the right side during examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。問診の変更内容を担当へ知らせます。ほかに書き直す所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I'll notify the clinician of the questionnaire changes. Is there anything else to rewrite?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 開始した日は昨日です。その日付も加えて提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 昨日からの症状として開始日も記入し提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: It started yesterday. I'll add that date and submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Add yesterday as the symptom start date and submit the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入後はこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please hand it here when you've finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 鍋を三人で分けたいです。取り分ける道具をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三人で鍋を分けるため取り分け道具を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The three of us would like to share the hot pot. Could we have serving utensils?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request serving utensils for three people to share a hot pot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お玉と取り分け用の箸をご用意します。小鉢も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll bring a ladle and serving chopsticks. Do you need small bowls too?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三人分お願いします。目の前の器は汁物が入っているので、鍋用には使わないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 汁の入った器を使わず三人分の小鉢を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Three, please. The bowls in front of us have soup in them, so we won't use those for the hot pot.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for three small bowls rather than using the bowls containing soup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では空の小鉢を三つお持ちします。鍋は熱いので手で動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll bring three empty small bowls. The pot is hot, so don't move it with your hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 鍋をこちらへ寄せようとしていました。置いたまま、お玉で取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鍋を寄せようとしていたが動かさずお玉を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was about to pull the pot closer. I'll leave it where it is and use the ladle.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you nearly moved the pot closer but will leave it and use a ladle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そのままの位置で届きにくい方がいれば、私が配置を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: If anyone has trouble reaching it there, I'll check the arrangement.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 奥の連れには届きにくいので、器だけ手前で受け取ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 奥の同行者へは手前で小鉢だけ渡すと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: My companion at the back has trouble reaching, so we'll just pass their bowl to them from the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Suggest passing just the small bowl from the front to the companion at the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。お玉は取り分け用としてお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Please use the ladle for serving.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 各自の箸を鍋に入れず、共用のお玉で空の小鉢へ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 個人箸を鍋へ入れず共用お玉で空小鉢へ分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: We won't put our personal chopsticks into the pot; we'll use the shared ladle to portion it into empty small bowls.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll use the communal ladle for empty bowls without putting personal chopsticks into the pot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-KESENNUMA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞお召し上がりください。

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。乗船のご案内で何かご質問がありますか。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have any questions about boarding?

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内の「右側の島」は、後ろ向きに座った私から見ても右でしょうか。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊覧船案内の右が後ろ向き着席時の自分の右か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: When the commentary says the island on the right, does it mean my right even if I'm sitting facing backward?
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether right in the sightseeing-boat commentary means your own right when seated backward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用案内の左右は、船の進行方向を向いたときの左右です。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this learning guide, left and right mean as you face the boat's direction of travel.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は後ろを向くつもりなので、自分の右と船の右が逆になりますね。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の予定座位では船の左右が逆になると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to face backward, so my right and the boat's right will be opposite, then.
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the boat's sides will be reversed from your planned seated orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。進行方向の矢印がある図で、見る側を先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. First check which side to look at on the diagram with the direction-of-travel arrow.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右と案内されたら、図の矢印と同じ向きになってから見るとよいですか。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図の矢印と同じ向きで見る側を確かめる方法を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: When they say right, would it help to face the same way as the arrow on the diagram before looking?
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about confirming the viewing side by aligning with the diagram's arrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 向きの理解にはそれが役立ちます。ただし航行中に無理に立って体を動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: That helps you understand the orientation. However, please don't stand up and move around unnecessarily while underway.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座ったまま図を向けて確かめます。外を見るのに身を乗り出しません。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立たず座ったまま図を合わせ身を乗り出さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stay seated and turn the diagram to check. I won't lean out to look outside.
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll align the diagram while seated without standing up or leaning out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。聞き取れない案内は係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. If you can't catch any commentary, ask a crew member.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左右を自分の座る向きで決めず、進行方向の図と合わせて聞きます。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 着席向きで左右を判断せず進行方向の図で案内を聞くと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't decide left and right by the way I'm sitting; I'll follow the commentary with the diagram of the travel direction.
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you'll use the travel-direction diagram rather than your seated orientation to interpret left and right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。どうぞ安全に景色をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-MYG-MATSUSHIMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please enjoy the scenery safely.
